records.command: cd "$TEMP/firstlight-shot" && for u in "/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fnyxx.png&w=1920&q=75" "/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Ffirstlight.jpg&w=1920&q=75"; do echo "== $u"; curl -s -D h.txt -o body.bin -H "Accept: image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,image/*,*/*;q=0.8" -H "Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br" --compressed --max-time 120 "http://localhost:3000$u"; grep -i "^HTTP\|content-type\|content-encoding\|content-length\|cache-control" h.txt; ls -la body.bin | awk '{print "body bytes:", $5}'; head -c 16 body.bin | od -An -c | head -2; done
